name: Gist in a Minute
niche: Educational channel about everything: science, space, the human body, psychology, history, tech, money and everyday “why” questions. One video — one clear gist in a minute, only verifiable facts.
audience: English-speaking viewers 14–45 who love learning something new from Shorts and Reels.

voice.name: Charon
voice.style: Lively and confident, like an enthusiastic storyteller: warm tone, clear diction, a hint of intrigue, no pathos.

voiceByPillar.note: Как в channel.json: голос и темп по рубрике. Пусто — голос канала (Gemini Charon, запасной — Edge en-US-ChristopherNeural).

schedule.note: Заготовка: время под аудиторию США. Загрузка в этот канал — отдельным ключом (см. README, «Ролики на других языках»).

cta.subscribe: Subscribe for a new gist every day
cta.comment: Tell me what you think in the comments
cta.onScreenComment: What do you think? Comment below
cta.rule: At the end: a question for the viewer (answer in the comments), then “subscribe”.

disclaimer: Videos are for general education and are not a substitute for professional advice (medical, legal or financial).
